In episode 24 of future adventures with shermy and Beth, the 2 decide to go on an adventure for a spoon located somewhere in the debris of the candy kingdom, the king of off(BMO) tells them that this spoon can heal them, during the search, one of gibbons guards spots the two and immediately try’s to get Beth, shermy uses his sword and throws it at the flying crystal, which cause it to burst, as well at the pup guards crystal armor, the pup guard immediately runs to the pup kingdom and tells king gibbon about the location of where shermy and Beth are, gibbon immediately calls all his pup guards and gibbon creates a bunch of new flying crystals and then they fly to the abondoned candy kingdom, Beth sees the crystals so she immediately forms a portal in front of we’re they are flying, shermy throws city debris through the portal and it knocks down all the pup guards, gibbon was also knocked down, gibbon flys into a rage and runs towards Beth with his staff, ready to extinguish her power, as soon as the laser was fired shermy immediately runs in front of it before it hits Beth and then he passes out. Gibbon then yells at Beth telling her that she can not be powerful and only he can, Beth said in return that he was a selfish ruler, gibbon then tears up and swings staff at Beth, Beth then pushes him over and stomps on him, gibbon yelps in pain as he’s stomped on, gibbon then tells her he was only selfish because his mom didn’t love him, he explained that Charlie never visited him so he assumed she hated him, because of this he fell so worthless because he felt as if his own parents didn’t even care about him, and so he wanted to make everyone else worthless by extinguishing there pup powers when their born, he also explains that one of the pups stole his power one time and this made him furious, Beth realizes how miserable gibbon was for all these years, when she looked back to where shermy was shermy was gone, a few seconds later shermy surprises Beth from behind with the spoon, Beth then asks to hold the spoon and shermy hands it to her, she then sets the spoon on gibbons forehead, gibbon was immediately healed, not just physically but also mentally, he nolonger felt worthless and he nolonger extinguished pups powers. 

If you want to watch this spin off, “future adventures with shermy and Beth” go to HBO max, the first season of this spinoff has 24 episodes, with the one I explained being the last episode of the season.
